stories.title: How a Gatlinburg homeowner turned into a 'garden hose firefighter'
stories.summary: During the historic 2016 wildfires, Steve Ogle spent an entire night protecting his homestead from flames using nothing but garden hoses.

stories.title: Gatlinburg rebuilds public works complex after 2016 wildfires
stories.summary: Ten years after the 2016 wildfires, Gatlinburg has transformed its public works complex with a $15 million investment in renovations and new facilities.

stories.title: 'I feel like it's been karma ever since' | Vol fans react to Lane Kiffin returning to town
stories.summary: Vol fans eagerly anticipate Saturday's game against LSU, expressing disdain for former head coach Lane Kiffin, who left Tennessee abruptly years ago.

stories.title: ORNL plays role in NASA's historic Voyager 1 mission
stories.summary: The national lab developed cladding and insulation to protect the spacecraft's power source.

stories.title: Construction plans announced for second building at $70 million national security center in Oak Ridge
stories.summary: The National Security Prototyping Center is expected to support about 200 jobs once complete.

stories.title: Future of Knox County Republican Party debated on upcoming "Inside TN" program
stories.summary: Gina Oster and Justin Cofer are WBIR's guests for the show, which will air 9:30 a.m. Sunday.

stories.title: American Heart Association donates AEDs to 5 Knoxville city parks
stories.summary: These five publicly accessible AEDs in Knoxville parks will enhance emergency response for over one million annual visitors.

stories.title: Plea deal in the works for former Sevier County Utility District president indicted for theft
stories.summary: Matthew Ballard, former president of Sevier County Utility District, has pleaded guilty to conspiracy and theft charges.

stories.title: Which areas in East Tennessee have issued burn bans?
stories.summary: Several areas have stopped issuing burn permits in recent days due to dry conditions.

stories.title: Gatlinburg and Pigeon Forge Fire Departments suspend burn permits amid high fire danger
stories.summary: The cities are encouraging residents and visitors to refrain from all outdoor burning.

stories.title: Newport teacher flies at zero-gravity with Space for Teachers program
stories.summary: Phillip Lewis is one of 12 teachers worldwide to participate in the flight.

stories.title: Knox Co. lieutenant faces internal review for writing letter of support for man who pleaded guilty to distributing child pornography
stories.summary: According to federal court documents, KCSO Lieutenant James Simonelli wrote a letter of support for a man who was sentenced to eight years in prison on Tuesday.
